references.text: Isaiah 53:1 contains the direct prophetic testimony about the Messiah that Jesus refers to when he says the Scriptures testify of him.
Isaiah 55:3 links the promise of eternal life directly to the hearer of God's word, paralleling the claim in John 5:39 that people believe they have eternal life in the Scriptures.
In John 12:38-41, John himself quotes Isaiah as testifying about Jesus, confirming that the same Scriptures Jesus mentions in chapter 5 indeed point to him.
John 19:36-37 shows how Jesus fulfills the specific Scriptures that testify of him, affirming that the Scriptures are witnesses to his identity.
Hebrews 10:7 illustrates how the Scriptures (the book of Psalms) testify about God's will for the Messiah, paralleling the way the Scriptures testify about Jesus in John 5:39.
John 5:46-47 is the immediate continuation where Jesus specifies that Moses' writings are those that testify of him, and that faith in these is decisive.
